svg.title: Expo 86 poster — reconstructed vector composition
svg.desc: The corrected vector reconstruction of the supplied Robert Davidson artwork, with the requested Expo 86 gallery logo, bilingual event information, artist credit, reconstructed 1985 signature, and a warm cream paper background. The artwork retains the restored reference proportions through uniform scaling. The surrounding page is reflowed from the photographed layout. The native vector components contain no embedded photograph.
